note:
R84 - EA-XMA (codec 0x03) bounded diagnostic-preview assessment on the Xbox 360 families: SNS-blocked speech (NHL 09 / 10 `ann_eng`
/ `pbp_eng`, 24 kHz mono), SNS-blocked music (NHL 09-12 `music_samples`, 44.1 kHz stereo) and raw `.abk` ram entries (NHL 09 archived,
NHL 10-Legacy loose: `000_goal`, `000_period`, `000_chant`, first 3 ram entries of `sfx.abk`).

Structure measured on NHL data: an SNS data block's payload (after the u32 block-samples word) is `u32 w0 | XMA2 packet bytes`, with
w0 >> 2 = payload length (low two bits: 0 on mono, 2 on stereo - recorded, not interpreted); the packet bytes start with a standard XMA2 packet header (u32 BE: 6-bit frame count | 15-bit first-frame bit
offset | 3-bit metadata | 8-bit packet skip) and are shorter than 0x800 - the block is one XMA2 packet that must be zero-padded to
0x800 for a decoder. A raw `.abk` segment is `u32 w0 | packet bytes` with w0 >> 2 = segment length (low bits 2) and consecutive 0x800
packets (last one partial). Multi-stream (> 2 channels) blocks carry one `u32 size | data` sub-block per stream (reference); only cc 0 / 1
are decoded here.
Reference (pinned, read, not vendored): vgmstream 4b6a02dd `src/meta/ea_eaac_streamfile.h` (SHA-256 d10ae126...): EA-XMA block =
num-samples, per-stream (size*4 + packets), data padded to XMA_FRAME_SIZE 0x800; `src/coding/ffmpeg_decoder_utils.c` (801434aa...):
`ffmpeg_make_riff_xma2` (WAVEFORMATEX tag 0x166, streams = (ch+1)/2, speaker mask, block size 0x10000) fed to FFmpeg's xma2 decoder;
vgmstream plays EA-XMA as XMA2 always. FFmpeg's `xma2` (wmaprodec.c) is the only decoder available here - no second implementation.
Tests per vector: T1 w0 == 4 x payload length on every block (raw: w0 >> 2 == segment length); T2 packet header sane (frame count > 0,
first-frame offset < payload bits); T3 sum(frame counts) x 512 vs sum(block samples) (delta recorded: first-block encoder delay + tail);
decode (diagnostic): RIFF XMA2 + padded packets -> ffmpeg xma2 -> s16le; decoded samples vs sum(block samples) / num_samples recorded.
Malformed controls: last block truncated by 3 bytes (w0 mismatch); w0 + 4; frame count 0 - each must be refused by name.
Usage: python r84_ea_xma_preview.py <out.json> [--trees a,b] [--keep]
